defects: The epi hypothesis is on the wrong morphism. In gold, Epi is assumed on f00x, an edge that (a) is used in exactly two of the five given commuting squares (h0xx and hx0x) and (b) whose source vertex (M000) lies outside every face touched by the conclusion, so that a diagram chase produces f00x ≫ (LHS) = f00x ≫ (RHS) which can then be cancelled. The analogous edge in the produced statement is f1 : A ⟶ B (used in h1 and h3, with source A outside the missing right face). Instead, the produced statement assumes Epi v3 (v3 : C ⟶ C'), which is itself one of the four edges of the target/missing face (it appears in the conclusion CommSq f2 v2 v3 g2) and appears in only one given hypothesis (h4). This hypothesis does not support the needed cancellation.

As a consequence the produced theorem is not just a differently-shaped equivalent statement but is actually false: a concrete counterexample exists in Set (8 vertices/finite sets satisfying h1–h5 and with v3 bijective/epi, but the 'right face' equation failing), so the produced statement asserts something that is not a theorem, unlike the gold statement.

Net effect: the conclusion square (missing face) and the epi hypothesis are mismatched relative to gold's combinatorial structure — the epi should be on an edge disjoint from the missing face's vertex set except at one shared target vertex, not on an edge internal to the missing face itself.
